get.description:
Stream a stored feedback image binary from private object storage.

Read-only and addressed by the image's unguessable storage key — it never
mutates state. The backend is the only reader of the object store, so the
bucket can stay private.

FeedbackSubmission.title: FeedbackSubmission
FeedbackSubmission.description:
Typed JSON body for feedback intake — each knowledge type is an array.

Item `partId`/`feedbackId`/`status` are ignored at intake — the handler
forces them (owned weak drafts).
